evidence.quote: Mesenteric tongue spheroidal

sources.title: Towards a revision of the Neotropical soldierless termites (Isoptera: Termitidae): redescription of the genus Grigiotermes Mathews and description of five new genera

sources.retrieved_via: web_fetch (Plazi treatment XHTML: publication.plazi.org/GgServer/xhtml/…) + Zenodo record 10529955 (deposit description)

evidence.quote: Humutermes workers have an elongated mixed segment with a whitish, spherical mesenteric diverticulum.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别：伸长的 mixed segment 与球形 diverticulum

evidence.quote: The genus mainly differs from Anoplotermes sensu stricto by the shape of its enteric valve, composed of six pads, each with ten to 20 long spines protruding into the paunch.
evidence.note: 与 Anoplotermes s.s. 的区别

evidence.quote: Imago: Eyes and ocelli of medium size. Fontanelle of medium size, appearing as an elongated white dot located between eyes.
evidence.note: 有翅成虫头部

evidence.quote: Patawatermes is very similar to Grigiotermes but can easily be distinguished from it by the shape of the armature of its worker enteric valve.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别：与 Grigiotermes 的区别

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into a tubular extension of the paunch, with well-developed armature composed of six rounded spiny pads.
evidence.note: 肠瓣插入位置与 armature

evidence.quote: Imago: Sclerotized body parts dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae.
evidence.note: 有翅成虫体色与刚毛

evidence.quote: Rubeotermes workers are distinctive from all other South American soldierless termites in that they turn red in alcohol and have some long and thick spines on the forecoxa.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别（唯一性）

evidence.quote: Mesenteron and proctodeum connection truncated, devoid of mixed segment.
evidence.note: 无 mixed segment

evidence.quote: Worker: Large, with head width of about 1 mm.
evidence.note: 属级体型

evidence.quote: Among neotropical snappers, the absence of a frontal projection distinguishes Schievitermes from Termes , Inquilinitermes , Cavitermes , Palmitermes , Dihoplotermes , and Cornicapritermes.
